entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A nation on eastern Terisiare during the Ice Age, founded by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, which later merged with the Balduvian lands into New Argive.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent where Kjeldor lay.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Kjeldor existed during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Balduvian barbarians
entities.description: Barbarians with whom Kjeldor had been in conflict for generations before allying against Lim-Dul.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The nation formed when Kjeldor merged with the Balduvian lands during the Thaw.

entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: The old capital of Kjeldor and location of the royal summer palace.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: The new capital of Kjeldor in the latter days of the Ice Age, home to the Royal Academy of Magic.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: An almost independent city located where Storgard had once stood.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: The kingdom of five clans from which Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald departed.

entities.name: Clan Pearl
entities.description: One of the two Storgard clans that founded Kjeldor.

entities.name: Clan Emerald
entities.description: One of the two Storgard clans that founded Kjeldor, led by Oriel Kjeldos.

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: The old leader of Clan Emerald, who died on the journey from Storgard; Kjeldor is named after her and her descendants became the royal family.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Neighboring elven land to the south with which Kjeldor established trade relations.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Royal mage who relied on willpower and charisma to keep wizard factions in control.

entities.name: Avram Garrison
entities.description: Unofficial leader of the military who, with Lim-Dul, formed the Knights of Stromgald and attempted a failed coup.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor who took firm control after the failed coup and rallied factions and the Balduvians against Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer who aided Garrison's coup, turned the Knights of Stromgald into zombified minions and became the common enemy of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: The order formed by Garrison and Lim-Dul that attempted a coup and was turned into Lim-Dul's zombified minions.

entities.name: General Varchild
entities.description: Leader of the unified Kjeldoran army who later went rogue and formed a militia against the Balduvians.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Cast the World Spell that ended the Ice Age but caused flooding and climate change.

entities.name: Jodah
aliases: Archmage Eternal of the School of the Unseen
entities.description: An archmage who helped forge the original alliance and convinced Darien and Lovisa Coldeyes to stop fighting.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: A Balduvian chieftain who agreed with Darien to cooperate.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: The group that brought on a brief return of the ice.

entities.name: Alexandrite
entities.description: Daughter of Darien who married Lothar to create the royal house of New Argive.

entities.name: Lothar
entities.description: Son of Lovisa Coldeyes who married Alexandrite.

entities.name: Knights of Kjeldor
entities.description: The combined knightly orders of Kjeldor during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: A Knight of Kjeldor who led Kaysa, Laina and the Fyndhorn elves into Yavimaya.

entities.name: Lord Rothchild
entities.description: Regent of eastern Kjeldor based in Jornstad after Lim-Dul's rise.

entities.name: Royal Academy of Magic
entities.description: The academy established at Krov after the capital moved.

entities.name: Feast of Kjeld
entities.description: An annual winter celebration honoring the nation's founder, held in Krov.

events.summary: Kjeldor is founded by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald, who leave Storgard before the ice covers it.
events.quote: Kjeldor was founded around 2434 AR by Clan Pearl and Clan Emerald

events.summary: Kjeldor trades with Fyndhorn, and elves teach its healers in exchange for keeping orcs at bay.
events.quote: The elves taught Kjeldor's healers in exchange for keeping the neighboring orcs at bay.

events.summary: The capital is moved from Kjeld to Krov, where the Royal Academy of Magic is established.
events.quote: At some point, the capital was moved from Kjeld to Krov

events.summary: By 2934 Kjeldor is weak and decentralized, with factions of wizards and the military split.
events.quote: By 2934, Kjeldor was weak and decentralized.

events.summary: Avram Garrison, aided by Lim-Dul, forms the Knights of Stromgald and attempts a coup, which fails; the Knights become zombified minions.
events.quote: The coup failed, and the Knights were turned into zombified minions of Lim-Dûl

events.summary: Darien takes firm control, unites the army under General Varchild and allies with the Balduvian barbarians against Lim-Dul.
events.quote: even made an alliance with the Balduvian barbarians

events.summary: After the final battle against Lim-Dul, the alliance shatters and Varchild goes rogue against the Balduvians.
events.quote: After the final battle against Lim-Dûl, the alliance shattered

events.summary: Freyalise casts her World Spell, ending the Ice Age but causing flooding and climate change.
events.quote: Freyalise cast her World Spell, which ended the Ice Age

events.summary: Jodah convinces Darien and Lovisa Coldeyes to stop fighting and cooperate, leading to the merger into New Argive.
events.quote: This cooperation would eventually result in the merger of the two countries into New Argive

events.summary: Alexandrite and Lothar marry, creating the royal house of New Argive.
events.quote: The royal house of this new nation was created in the marriage of Alexandrite

relations.note: Old leader of the clan; Kjeldor is named after her.
relations.quote: the old leader of Clan Emerald

relations.note: Aided by him in the coup.

relations.quote: formed the Knights of Stromgald and attempted a coup

relations.note: The Knights became his zombified minions.
relations.quote: the Knights were turned into zombified minions of Lim-Dûl
even made an alliance with the Balduvian barbarians

relations.note: Led the unified army under him.
relations.quote: one army led by General Varchild
